evidence.quote: Several problems concerning the topological character of (non-locally-convex) complete metric linear spaces, their convex subsets, and the homotopy type of the Inear groups of Banach spaces are discussed.
This review text is based on a scanned copy of the printed version. It was converted to LaTeX using MathPix and a specifically developed LLM to assign the text parts to the metadata.
